title: 15 minutes of fun! Then wait a month
text: Was is fun? YES was is worth the money? NO. My husband and I were so excited we put the kids to bed early and cleared the table. We read and went over all the materials, took some notes, discussed, and eliminated a suspect all in less than 15 minutes. The story is great but I can’t justify the $30 for the next month and I wouldn’t be able to wait that long either. If it was say $10-$15 and it was weekly I’d love it.
label: negative
